title: 有馬記念の後に・笑顔の花火

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen is the year's last big race, and Kitasan Black has crossed the finish line ahead of the pack.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The final factor that led her to victory was the countless fans cheering for her. Her dream of bringing smiles to all has come true at last.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black and Satono Diamond promise to continue running together from here on out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black has become the festival guru and receives a ground-shaking ovation. She's surrounded by smiles as she proudly stands as everyone's most beloved Umamusume.
